_readme: Hand-curated donor entities for parli.ingest.donor_entities.
Every entry is one real-world donor. `aliases` lists OTHER spellings that
belong to it; each alias also claims its whole rule-normalised group, so one
spelling per distinct legal-suffix/branch variant is enough (listing
'Westpac Banking Corporation' also captures 'WESTPAC BANKING CORP').
An entry with no aliases is a PIN: it stops the automatic rule tier from
folding that name into a look-alike (National Australia Bank vs National
Union of Workers, Insurance Australia Group vs Insurance Council of
Australia, Endeavour Group vs Endeavour Energy).
Rules applied here:
- union branches roll UP to the parent union; the branch is kept on the
alias row so a donor page can say 'also disclosed as: NSW Branch'
- individuals merge only on the person-normalised exact match: honorifics
and post-nominals off and 'Surname, Given' turned around ('Turpie, Duncan'
= 'Mr Duncan Turpie' = 'Duncan Turpie'). A person is curated only for a
given-name short form with the same surname and the same recipients
('Pam Wall' = 'Pamela Wall'); surname-plus-initial never merges
- a company and its distinctly-branded operating businesses stay apart
(Wilson Parking / Wilson Security); only spellings, typos, branches and
renames of the SAME business merge
- successor unions and demergers stay apart with a note, because merging
them would silently rewrite historical totals
- anything genuinely ambiguous stays separate and says why in `notes`
